- Fixed bug where you could release your Fable through the new multi-release in Fable Storage (not intended as I want to avoid hard locks and other systems rely on having a starter)
- Fixed bug that caused blank screen in Trader (due to releasing starter with multi-release)
- Fixed bug in save patcher not removing training buddies (causing them to get stuck until you bought the buddies upgrade again)

notes.title: Achievements Update + Future of Fableverse
notes.content:
[h1]Achievement Update[/h1]
I've finally finished the Achievements update, which now adds 30 achievements for you to collect and obtain. The icons are each of the Fables. Some of the achievements will be retroactive to your saves, so all you'll have to do is open up your save to earn them (if you've earned it). Some will not be retroactive and will need to be done again. 

Another minor change is now when you start a new game, you will see all the unlockable sections in the game, but as a "???" instead of being completely hidden. This is to help with knowing if there's content left, but also to let players know there is more content.

Lastly, I did change the legendary chance of showing up with traders from 5% to 10% to help a bit with the RNG aspects.

[h1]Future of Fableverse (See Note Below, this has been retracted)[/h1]
One thing I've been really focused on lately is how I can innovate on my idea for this game and build something better, longer lasting, and in-depth. The focus would be more on battling, automation, and strategy instead of solely collecting and idling. In order to make the changes I want to make, it will be much more appropriate as a sequel as the core game will really change and I want to respect those who really enjoy the simplicity and focus on collecting. I'll still try and keep up with bugs and minor improvements, but will now be focusing on Fableverse 2.

[h1]Note: I have since changed my stance on no more updates[/h1]
Hi all, I have since retracted my statement on no more updates. I've heard you all and will be focusing on fixing the larger issues with the gameplay and looking to add a bit more depth to the game, as I work on Fableverse 2 vs. completely abandoning it. Refer to the Pinned Discussion for more information: https://steamcommunity.com/app/2233750/discussions/0/4339851480064195921/


Thank you all for your support!

notes.title: Major Patch v1.1.0
notes.content:
[New]
- Added Time Stones as an offline and in-game time mechanic, to be spent on special features. Earned every 30 minutes.
- Added an Additional Options page with the ability to disable animations, offline progress, and the confirm release popup
- Added a Slider for selling a portion of your minerals vs. all
- Added new mechanic: Genetic Lab, that allows you to improve the genes of Fables with Time Stones that unlocks at level 30
- Added a Sorting Dropdown: Augments
- Added an Ascending checkbox for sorting, so you can switch between ascending/descending
- Added a "Items Per Page" for the Fable Selector, which allows you to display more fables if desired
- Added a "Switch Ore for All" button in the mining screen
- Added a "Remove All" button in the mining screen to remove all fables mining
- Added Burst mining, which gives you an average of 5 minutes worth of mining gains.

[Change]
- Changed Time Cube healing in training to Rare Candy-like mechanic using Time Stones
- Changed wording of the Athletics upgrade
- Changed file export format, to be based on ISO time format which includes date and time
- Added a "None' option on every filter to reset it, without reseting all the other Options
- Augmenter Cost Button now shows mineral image and is much clearer on what your paying with

[Balances]
- Buffed the profit minerals sell price (minerals not used for augments), to hopefully give more use to them
- Buffed the starter base stats slightly, to make early game a bit easier/faster
- Your first Starter now has 100% Vibrancy to start off with

[Bug Fix]
- Trader no longer trades for the same thing it's looking for
- Fixed the Level Sorting Filter
- Rephrased Time Jumper upgrade to be more clear
- Removed the Steam overlay animation loop (its not be used anyways) for an overall CPU usage decrease
- Fixed bug that let you double click the release button, causing it to randomly release another fable
